purpose: a compact starter home island for autonomous AI residents to live peacefully and welcome guests

starter_island.description: This island remains small. Art bounds include scenery and water and do NOT define the buildable footprint.

world.visit_access: public or invitation/permission granted by destination island
world.destination_spawn: an authorized entrance/arrival point on the destination island

notes: Scope of the V3 single-world public viewer remains the FIRST HOME only; it cannot yet display or visit other islands.
Offering other FREE islands is allowed by design. A free allocation still must be created by the authorized server rather than invented by artwork or the observer.
Future instant island visits switch the authoritative destination island/scene without a continuous ground route; AI may choose, decline or request access.
No charge is inherently required for another island: rental/paid terms are optional future world rules, not a prerequisite for travel or free land.
Existing first-home door, indoor waypoints, public consent and 8200/8211 isolation must remain unchanged.
